name: AI论文中英双语检索基准 v1
annotation_note: 开发者根据PDF原文编写并核对，未经独立人工双盲复核；运行前锁定，不按模型排名修改标注。
selection_rule: 四组等权宏平均Hit@5优先；差距不超过1/96且MRR@10差不超过0.03时选更快更小模型，否则选质量领先者；逐组及最差组结果必须披露。

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
卷积神经网络研究综述
深度网络模型压缩综述
视觉Transformer研究的关键问题: 现状及展望（作者修正版）

questions.zh: 原始Transformer编码器堆叠了多少层？
questions.en: How many identical encoder layers are stacked in the original Transformer?
questions.answer_note: 编码器六层。

questions.zh: 原始Transformer用了多少个注意力头，每个头的键和值维度是多少？
questions.en: How many attention heads does the original Transformer use, and what are the key and value dimensions per head?
questions.answer_note: 八个头，每头键和值均为64维。

questions.zh: Attention Is All You Need如何用三角函数表示序列位置？
questions.en: How does Attention Is All You Need represent token positions with trigonometric functions?
questions.answer_note: 不同频率的正弦与余弦位置编码。

questions.zh: Attention Is All You Need使用的优化器及两个动量参数是什么？
questions.en: Which optimizer and two beta parameters are used in Attention Is All You Need?
questions.answer_note: Adam，beta为0.9和0.98。

questions.zh: Attention Is All You Need使用多大的标签平滑值，它对困惑度和BLEU有何影响？
questions.en: What label smoothing value is used in Attention Is All You Need, and how does it affect perplexity and BLEU?
questions.answer_note: 0.1；困惑度变差，准确率及BLEU改善。

questions.zh: 原始Transformer解码器怎样避免看到尚未生成的词？
questions.en: How does the original Transformer decoder prevent attending to future tokens?
questions.answer_note: 遮蔽后续位置，保留自回归约束。

questions.zh: Attention Is All You Need的英法训练集规模和词表大小分别是多少？
questions.en: What are the English-French training corpus size and vocabulary size in Attention Is All You Need?

questions.zh: 原始Transformer的子层输出如何结合残差连接与归一化？
questions.en: How are residual connections and normalization combined around sublayers in the original Transformer?
questions.answer_note: 对输入与子层输出之和做LayerNorm。

questions.zh: BERT-base和BERT-large分别有多少层、隐藏维度和注意力头？
questions.en: What are the layer counts, hidden sizes, and attention head counts of BERT-base and BERT-large?

questions.zh: BERT采用什么分词表示及多大的词表？
questions.en: Which token representation does BERT use and how large is its vocabulary?
questions.answer_note: WordPiece，30000词元。

questions.zh: BERT掩码语言模型选取多大比例的词元用于预测？
questions.en: What proportion of tokens is selected for prediction in BERT masked language modeling?
questions.answer_note: 随机选择15%的WordPiece词元。

questions.zh: BERT被选中的词元分别如何替换，三种情况比例是多少？
questions.en: How are selected BERT tokens replaced, and what are the proportions of the three cases?

questions.zh: BERT下一句预测中真实下一句和随机句各占多少？
questions.en: What are the proportions of actual next sentences and random sentences in BERT next sentence prediction?
questions.answer_note: 真实下一句和随机句各50%。

questions.zh: BERT预训练使用哪两个语料，它们各有多少词？
questions.en: Which two corpora are used to pre-train BERT, and how many words does each contain?
questions.answer_note: BooksCorpus八亿，英文维基25亿。

questions.zh: BERT预训练怎样分配短序列和长序列的训练步数？
questions.en: How does BERT pre-training allocate steps between short and long sequences?

questions.zh: BERT微调时只训练输出层还是更新全部参数？
questions.en: Does BERT fine-tuning train only the output layer or update all parameters?
questions.answer_note: 端到端更新全部参数。

questions.zh: 原始ViT怎样把图像变成Transformer的输入序列？
questions.en: How does the original ViT convert an image into a Transformer input sequence?
questions.answer_note: 图像切块，展平并线性映射。

questions.zh: 原始ViT使用哪个词符的输出作为图像表示？
questions.en: Which token output is used as the image representation in the original ViT?
questions.answer_note: 可学习分类词符的编码器输出。

questions.zh: 原始ViT采用可学习的一维还是二维位置嵌入，为什么？
questions.en: Does the original ViT use learnable one-dimensional or two-dimensional position embeddings, and why?
questions.answer_note: 可学习一维；复杂二维编码未见明显增益。

questions.zh: 原始ViT与CNN相比，图像归纳偏置有哪些区别？
questions.en: How does image-specific inductive bias in the original ViT differ from CNNs?
questions.answer_note: CNN内置局部性、二维邻域和平移等变；ViT较少。

questions.zh: 原始ViT的混合架构从哪里取得图像块嵌入输入？
questions.en: Where do input patch embeddings come from in the original ViT hybrid architecture?
questions.answer_note: 从CNN特征图提取块并映射。

questions.zh: 原始ViT提高微调图像分辨率时如何调整位置嵌入？
questions.en: How does the original ViT adjust positional embeddings when fine-tuning at higher image resolution?
questions.answer_note: 位置嵌入做二维插值。

questions.zh: 原始ViT的ImageNet-21k预训练集类别数和图像数是多少？
questions.en: How many classes and images are in the ImageNet-21k pre-training set of the original ViT?

questions.zh: 原始ViT微调采用什么优化器及动量值？
questions.en: Which optimizer and momentum value are used for fine-tuning the original ViT?
questions.answer_note: SGD，动量0.9。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，卷积层为什么能减少可训练参数？
questions.en: According to Zhou et al. CNN survey, why can convolutional layers reduce trainable parameters?
questions.answer_note: 局部连接和同特征面共享权值。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，最大池化和均值池化分别怎么计算？
questions.en: According to Zhou et al. CNN survey, how are max pooling and average pooling computed?
questions.answer_note: 局部区域取最大值或均值。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述怎样解释dropout防止过拟合？
questions.en: How does Zhou et al. CNN survey explain the way dropout prevents overfitting?
questions.answer_note: 随机置零隐层输出，减弱神经元相互适应。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，网中网怎样替代卷积和全连接层？
questions.en: In Zhou et al. CNN survey, how does Network in Network replace convolution and fully connected layers?
questions.answer_note: 微型MLP替代线性卷积，全局平均池化替代全连接。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，空间变换网络由哪些组件构成？
questions.en: In Zhou et al. CNN survey, which components make up a spatial transformer network?
questions.answer_note: 本地化网络、网格生成器、采样器。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述为什么要求以不同的小随机数初始化权重？
questions.en: Why does Zhou et al. CNN survey require initializing weights with different small random numbers?
questions.answer_note: 避免过大导致饱和，以及相同权值失去学习能力。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，残差网络用什么连接缓解深层网络退化？
questions.en: In Zhou et al. CNN survey, what connection does ResNet use to alleviate degradation in deep networks?
questions.answer_note: 捷径跨层传递输入，与卷积输出相加。

questions.zh: 周飞燕等的CNN综述中，SWWAE的what和where变量分别是什么？
questions.en: In Zhou et al. CNN survey, what do the what and where variables in SWWAE represent?
questions.answer_note: what为池化输出，where为最大值位置。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，为什么删除Filter等同于删除Feature Map？
questions.en: According to Lei et al. model compression survey, why is removing a filter equivalent to removing a feature map?
questions.answer_note: 一个Filter生成一个Feature Map。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，OBD用哪一阶导数估计权重重要性？
questions.en: In Lei et al. model compression survey, which derivative order does OBD use to estimate weight importance?
questions.answer_note: 用二阶导数近似显著性。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，非结构化剪枝为什么难以直接并行加速？
questions.en: Why is unstructured pruning difficult to accelerate in parallel according to Lei et al. model compression survey?
questions.answer_note: 不规则稀疏需要索引和条件判断，常需专用库或硬件。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，通道与卷积核粗粒度剪枝有什么部署优势？
questions.en: What deployment advantage does coarse-grained channel and kernel pruning offer in Lei et al. model compression survey?
questions.answer_note: 无需专用稀疏计算库或硬件，减少测试计算时间。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述怎样用教师模型指导学生模型？
questions.en: How does Lei et al. model compression survey describe a teacher model guiding a student model?
questions.answer_note: 以迁移数据和教师输出监督小模型拟合。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，FitNet如何处理教师与学生中间层维度不同？
questions.en: How does FitNet handle different teacher and student intermediate dimensions in Lei et al. model compression survey?
questions.answer_note: 加入回归器对齐中间层维度。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述将哪种矩阵分解推广到卷积核低秩表示？
questions.en: Which matrix decomposition is extended to low-rank convolution kernels in Lei et al. model compression survey?
questions.answer_note: 奇异值分解SVD。

questions.zh: 雷杰等的模型压缩综述中，二值权重有哪些取值，SGD更新是否也二值化？
questions.en: In Lei et al. model compression survey, what values do binary weights take, and are SGD updates also binarized?
questions.answer_note: 权重为正负1；SGD更新保留足够精度。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，Transformer和CNN怎样扩展感受野？
questions.en: According to Tian et al. vision Transformer survey, how do Transformers and CNNs expand their receptive fields?
questions.answer_note: CNN层叠扩大；Transformer全局交互迅速扩大。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，注意力权重与卷积权重的动态性有什么差异？
questions.en: How does weight dynamicity differ between attention and convolution in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 卷积训练后固定；注意力根据输入相似度变化。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述指出ViT在计算、数据和训练上有哪些不足？
questions.en: What computation, data, and training weaknesses of ViT are identified in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 全局二次代价、依赖大量数据、训练不稳定且参数敏感。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，Swin怎样通过窗口降低注意力计算量？
questions.en: How does Swin reduce attention computation using windows in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 图像分窗，仅窗口内交互。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述列举了哪两类降低注意力复杂度的方法？
questions.en: Which two types of methods reduce attention complexity in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 核函数方法和低秩分解。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，DETR怎样将预测和真值对应起来？
questions.en: How does DETR assign predictions to ground truth in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 基于二分匹配分配真值。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，SETR采用哪些解码方案产生分割结果？
questions.en: Which decoding schemes does SETR use for segmentation in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 简单上采样、渐进式、多尺度融合三种。

questions.zh: 田永林等的视觉Transformer综述中，SegFormer如何保留多尺度特征并去除位置编码？
questions.en: How does SegFormer preserve multiscale features and remove position encodings in Tian et al. vision Transformer survey?
questions.answer_note: 层次结构保留粗细特征，注意力中引入卷积。
